# {{ site.Title }}

> AI-driven tracker for carbon dioxide removal (CDR). Every startup, paper,
> and policy move worth knowing about — synthesized daily by an AI named
> Captain Drawdown. Operated by Dirk Paessler / Carbon Drawdown Initiative
> (carbon-drawdown.de). All content is freely republishable with
> attribution under CC-BY-4.0.

## What this site is for

- Use the Daily CDR Log for the current week's CDR news distilled to one paragraph per story.
- Use the Pathway 101 series for evergreen explainers on how each CDR pathway works, who does it, and how durable it is.
- Use the CDR Directory for the ~800 companies we track in this space, with refresh dates and pathway focus.
- Use the CDR Census for the academic research-cluster view (who publishes, who collaborates).
